meta.source: Original direction 'Kohl & Malachite', 2026-10. No inherited brand values.

color.note: One light theme. Darkness is used locally (kohl surfaces) for evening-routine context rather than as a global dark mode.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background on every screen — warm limestone, never pure white, so product photos and white packaging read as objects.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, inputs, the bottom nav — anything that sits on paper.

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: The product niche: the arch-topped photo well behind every product image; also sunken wells and the segmented-tab track.

tokens.name: sand-deep
tokens.usage: Skeleton loaders, pressed state of sand wells, the empty-state niche.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dividers between list rows. Never the only cue for a control edge.

tokens.name: line-field
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, steppers, secondary buttons and unselected chips — 3.5:1 on paper, 3.9:1 on paper-raised, 3.1:1 on sand.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Kohl. Primary text and icons on paper, paper-raised, sand and every -soft tint (≥12:1). Also the selected-chip fill and the focus ring.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text — brand names, metadata, descriptions — on paper, paper-raised, sand and the -soft tints (≥5.3:1).

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: placeholders, helper text, timestamps, on paper and paper-raised (≥5:1) and sand (4.5:1). Not for anything smaller than 12px.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels only (exempt from contrast); always paired with a non-colour cue such as the missing pointer/hover and reduced border.

tokens.name: malachite
tokens.usage: Brand and commerce action: primary button fill, active nav item, links, success. As text on paper (5.8:1), paper-raised (6.4:1) and malachite-soft (5.4:1).

tokens.name: malachite-deep
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed of malachite fills; AI-guide text on guide-surface.

tokens.name: malachite-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind malachite text: selected filter count, 'in your routine' badges, success notices.

tokens.name: on-malachite
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a malachite or malachite-deep fill (6.4:1 / 9.9:1).

tokens.name: henna
tokens.usage: Offers only: discount stamps, sale price text. On paper 5.4:1, paper-raised 5.9:1, henna-soft 4.9:1. Never for errors.

tokens.name: henna-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind henna text in offer badges and the offer strip.

tokens.name: on-henna
tokens.usage: Text on a henna fill (the discount stamp), 6:1.

tokens.name: saffron
tokens.usage: Morning routine (sun disc, AM bead) and 'action required' markers. A fill only — text on it is ink (7.8:1); never use saffron as text.

tokens.name: saffron-soft
tokens.usage: Morning-routine card ground and the attention notice background.

tokens.name: saffron-ink
tokens.usage: Text in saffron contexts (attention notice title, low-stock line) on saffron-soft (6.4:1) or paper (6.5:1).

tokens.name: kohl
tokens.usage: Evening-routine surface and the routine 'player'. The only dark ground in the system — reserved for PM/night context.

tokens.name: kohl-raised
tokens.usage: Cards and step rows sitting on a kohl surface.

tokens.name: on-kohl
tokens.usage: Primary text on kohl (13:1) and kohl-raised (11:1).

tokens.name: on-kohl-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text on kohl (8.1:1) and kohl-raised (6.9:1).

tokens.name: malachite-on-kohl
tokens.usage: Malachite accents on kohl surfaces: done beads, progress, links (7.5:1 on kohl).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions: field error text and border, failed payment. On paper 5.9:1, paper-raised 6.5:1, danger-soft 5.3:1. Always with the alert icon — never colour alone.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of error notices.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill (rare: destructive confirm), 6.6:1.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons — alias of malachite so brand and 'done' stay one green.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Success notice background.

tokens.name: attention
tokens.usage: 'Action required' marker fills (order status bead, notice stripe). Text uses attention-ink.

tokens.name: attention-soft
tokens.usage: 'Action required' notice background.

tokens.name: attention-ink
tokens.usage: Text in attention notices.

tokens.name: guide
tokens.usage: AI-guide text, lens glyph and labels, on guide-surface (9:1) or paper.

tokens.name: guide-line
tokens.usage: The dashed 1.5px outline that marks AI-originated suggestions (5.8:1 on paper). Dashed = a suggestion, not a fact.

tokens.name: guide-surface
tokens.usage: Ground of guide hints and suggestion chips.

tokens.name: price
tokens.usage: Regular price text.

tokens.name: price-sale
tokens.usage: Sale price text when an old price is shown beside it.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring colour on light grounds (see focus-ring shadow). On kohl surfaces the ring switches to on-kohl.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind bottom sheets and drawers (kohl at 55%).

families.display: "Alexandria", "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", "Segoe UI", Tahoma, sans-serif
families.text: "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", "Segoe UI", Tahoma, Arial, sans-serif

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Alexandria (Google Fonts, Arabic + Latin, variable 100–900). Headlines, prices, routine names. Never below 18px.

styles.name: t-display-xl
styles.usage: Desktop hero and auth panel headline only.

styles.name: t-display-l
styles.usage: Mobile hero, routine name on the routine screen, desktop page titles.

styles.name: t-display-m
styles.usage: Mobile page titles, sheet titles on desktop, category card titles.

styles.name: t-title
styles.usage: Section headings, product name on PDP, routine card name.

styles.name: t-price-l
styles.usage: Price on the product page and the checkout total.

styles.name: t-price
styles.usage: Price on product cards and cart rows.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: IBM Plex Sans Arabic (Google Fonts) with its matched Plex Latin. Arabic needs taller leading than Latin: body runs at ~1.6.

styles.name: t-heading
styles.usage: Card titles, list group headings, notice titles.

styles.name: t-body-l
styles.sample: بيرطّب من غير ما يسيب لمعة، ومناسب للبشرة الحساسة.
styles.usage: Long-form product descriptions and guide answers.

styles.name: t-body
styles.usage: Default UI text, product names on cards, inputs.

styles.name: t-body-s
styles.usage: Metadata, helper text, delivery and stock lines.

styles.name: t-label
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, chips, bottom-nav labels at 12px use t-caption instead.

styles.name: t-caption
styles.usage: Badges, brand names on cards, nav labels, step counters. Smallest size in the system.

spacing.note: 4px base. Mobile gutters space-4, tablet space-6, desktop space-8.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside chips; bead-to-rail gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips; inside badges; between price and old price.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Product card inner padding; gap between grid cards on mobile.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile page gutter; card padding; gap between form fields.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Sheet padding; routine card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Tablet gutter; space between sections on mobile.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop gutter; space between sections on tablet.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Section spacing on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Hero padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Large desktop section breaks, auth panel padding.

radius.note: Pills you press, arches you look at, rectangles you read.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Badges, discount stamps, thumbnail corners.

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: Inputs, OTP boxes, content cards (concern, brand, cart summary).

tokens.name: radius-m
tokens.usage: Routine cards, notices, guide hints, drawers.

tokens.name: radius-l
tokens.usage: Top corners of bottom sheets; the desktop auth panel.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Everything pressable: buttons, chips, search bar, steppers, segmented tabs.

tokens.name: radius-arch
tokens.usage: Vertical radius of the product-niche arch on cards (top corners only: 50% horizontal / radius-arch vertical).

tokens.name: radius-arch-l
tokens.usage: Vertical radius of the arch on the product gallery and auth panel.

shadow.note: Flat by default; hairlines separate. Shadows only for things that float above the page.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Bottom nav, sticky add-to-cart bar, popovers.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and drawers.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on light grounds: 2px paper gap, then 2px solid ink (14:1). Applied as box-shadow so it follows pills and arches.

tokens.name: focus-ring-on-kohl
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus inside kohl (evening) surfaces.

layout.note: Breakpoints are min-widths. Compose per form factor; never stretch the mobile layout.

tokens.name: bp-tablet
tokens.usage: ≥600: 3-column product grid, filters move into a start-side drawer, bottom nav stays.

tokens.name: bp-desktop
tokens.usage: ≥1024: site header replaces top bar + bottom nav; persistent filter rail; 4-column grid; sticky purchase column on PDP.

tokens.name: bp-wide
tokens.usage: ≥1440: content stops growing at container-max; margins absorb the rest.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Maximum content width on desktop.

tokens.name: col-filter-rail
tokens.usage: Width of the persistent filter rail on desktop listing.

tokens.name: col-purchase
tokens.usage: Width of the sticky purchase column on desktop PDP and the checkout summary.

size.note: Touch first: nothing tappable under 44px on mobile.

tokens.name: control-s
tokens.usage: Compact buttons and chips (desktop toolbars, inside cards).

tokens.name: control-m
tokens.usage: Default buttons, chips, steppers, search bar; the minimum touch target.

tokens.name: control-l
tokens.usage: Primary purchase buttons, form inputs, OTP boxes.

tokens.name: icon-s
tokens.usage: Icons inside chips, badges and inline text.

tokens.name: icon-m
tokens.usage: Default icon size: nav, top bar, buttons.

tokens.name: bead
tokens.usage: Routine step bead and order-status bead diameter.

tokens.name: bottom-nav-h
tokens.usage: Mobile bottom navigation height (plus safe-area inset).

duration.note: Short and calm. Respect prefers-reduced-motion: drop to 0ms except opacity fades.

tokens.name: dur-instant
tokens.usage: Pressed states, chip toggles, checkbox ticks.

tokens.name: dur-quick
tokens.usage: Hover, focus, tab indicator slide, add-to-cart confirmation swap.

tokens.name: dur-settle
tokens.usage: Cards expanding, routine bead filling, guide hint appearing.

tokens.name: dur-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and drawers entering; leaving uses dur-settle.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Default for anything entering or responding to touch.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Indicators moving between positions (tabs, progress).

tokens.name: ease-in
tokens.usage: Sheets and toasts leaving.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky purchase bar, sticky filter row.

tokens.name: z-nav
tokens.usage: Top bar and bottom nav.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim, bottom sheets, drawers.
